verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own AI Assistant takes natural-language direction to read threads, write drafts, search email history, check your calendar, and run workflows across connected apps. Users can also write inbox-automation filters in plain English, schedule sends in natural language, and tell the assistant to remember preferences. missing for 10: explicit documentation that chat commands can carry out every inbox action (archive, label, send) rather than mainly reading and drafting, and independent hands-on corroboration of the AI assistant (the community reports predate the AI features).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
